reviews.text:
In a good way, it's understated.

I recommend it.

I took my pet cat to this veterinary clinic because I thought it had a good reputation. However, when they found out I had pet insurance, they charged me an extremely high fee. For example, a complete set of blood tests cost just under 70,000 yen.
Also, my cat became ill, and when I took him to the clinic, he suddenly died two days later. I thought it was a coincidence, but my second cat also stopped treatment 10 days after starting.
To be honest, I'm skeptical about whether this is an honest clinic. They often charge high fees, so I definitely can't recommend this veterinary clinic.

I have two cats here.

My cats hate hospitals and always get violent, so at our previous hospital, I had to forcefully restrain them, which made them cry and act up even more, and they would obviously make faces.

But since we switched to this hospital, they've been treating my cats with great care and gently monitoring their condition, so I think my cats feel more at ease and they've become less fussy since we started coming here.

The doctor is very serious, kind, and thorough in his examinations, and he explains things carefully. He also carefully monitors my cats' moods and performs tests accordingly.

Compared to our previous hospital, the nurses are also very kind and polite, and I can tell they love animals, which I really like.

I don't think you could find a better hospital than this. I plan to continue using their care here.

They were very helpful when I called for advice, and the doctor was kind and gentle. My cat especially loves the nurse. He seems happy that she keeps petting him.

I deducted one star because he came home with fleas after the neutering surgery, so I think he might have caught them in the cage.

The teacher is very kind and trustworthy.

10 stars!

It's a bit far, but I want to keep going there.

Our three cats are under the care of this clinic. The head veterinarian sees them every time for regular checkups and vaccinations, and we feel confident entrusting them to him because of his thorough examinations, careful listening, and detailed explanations.

He also answers questions sincerely. Because of this, the consultation time is a little longer, and there is also a waiting time from the appointment time.

We had all three cats spayed/neutered, and the explanations and handover process were very thorough.

We had our two cats spayed/neutered here.

The explanations were very clear and easy to understand, even for a first-timer. The doctor is very trustworthy and reassuring.

We will definitely be using their services again in the future.
